# Guardian Recruiters

> Premier job advertising and talent acquisition platform offering sector-specific recruitment solutions, job posting packages, CV search, and employer branding services.

Guardian Recruiters is The Guardian's dedicated recruitment solutions platform serving employers and recruiters across multiple industries. It provides comprehensive job advertising products, candidate search capabilities, and employer branding services to help organizations attract top talent through The Guardian's trusted brand and audience of over 1 million candidates.

## Key Topics

- Job Advertising
- Talent Acquisition
- Guardian Jobs
- CV Search
- Employer Branding
- Recruitment Solutions
- Job Posting Packages
- Bronze/Silver/Express Job Ads
- Guardian Jobs Subscription

- Sector-Specific Recruitment

- Recruitment Platform
- Job Board
- Pricing Packages

## Job Advertising Products

- [Premier Talent Acquisition | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com): Guardian Recruiters homepage showcasing job advertising platform and talent acquisition solutions.
- [Job adverts | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/job-advertising-products): Job advertising products overview including Bronze, Silver, and Express job ad packages.
- [Advertise a job | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/advertise-a-job): Job advertising landing page showcasing Guardian's recruitment packages and solutions.
- [Bronze Job Ad | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/products/bronze-job-ad): Bronze Job Ad product: 30-day branded listing on Guardian Jobs for smaller budgets.
- [Silver Job Ad | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/products/silver-job-ad): Silver Job Ad product with social promotion targeting hard-to-reach candidates.
- [Express Job Ad | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/products/express-job-ad): Express Job Ad: 7-day branded listing on Guardian Jobs for urgent recruitment.
- [Guardian Jobs Subscription | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/products/guardian-jobs-subscription): Guardian Jobs Subscription: unlimited annual job posting plan for continuous recruitment.

## Candidate Search & Recruitment Solutions

- [CV Search | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/products/cv-search): CV Search product: access 375,000+ candidate CVs with direct contact capabilities.
- [Industry-Specific & Sector Recruitment | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/sectors): Sector-specific recruitment solutions reaching over 1 million candidates across industries.

## Branding & Display Solutions

- [Branding and display | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/branding-and-display-products): Branding and display advertising solutions for employer branding and candidate search.
- [Display advertising | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/branding-and-display-products/display-advertising): Display advertising solutions using Guardian Target, Amplify, and Light targeting products.
- [Employer branding | Guardian Recruiters](https://recruiters.theguardian.com/branding-and-display-products/employer-branding): Employer branding solutions helping recruiters attract right-fit candidates.
